title: Supply Installation and testing of street lights at Chudeshwar VTS radar station
summary: GeM BOQ bid for supply, installation and testing of LED street lights on GI poles with underground armoured cabling at the Chudeshwar VTS radar station (Devbhumi Dwarka, Gujarat) under the VTS Directorate Gandhidham.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate General of Lighthouses and Lightships, Gandhidham (VTS Directorate)

sites.name: Chudeshwar VTS Radar Station, Salaya Post, Taluka Khambhaliya, Dist. Devbhumi Dwarka
sites.work: Supply, installation and testing of street lights with poles, UG cabling, MCBs and junction boxes

scope.item: Class C Heavy duty GI Pipe Reputed Brand
Class C Heavy duty GI Pipe Reputed Brand for double light fitting
25 mm good quality PVC Pipe
25mm band 180 Socket 50 Total 230 Nos
25mm Gray steel wire reinforced PVC flexible pipe
Close type 6 Way 32A Bakelite Terminal block heavy duty connector (29 pole, 1 gate light, 6 spare)
LED Street light 25W 230V 50Hz AC (41 Nos and 4 spare) reputed brand
1.5 Sqmm x 3C Armoured cable reputed brand
6A 240V Single pole MCB reputed brand (41 Nos, 1 for gate light, 4 spare)
MCB Box without MCB, 4 way MCB sheet metal enclosure
16A 240V Double Pole MCB reputed brand (2 Nos and 2 spare)
Electrical pole Junction Box 250x200x100mm NA394 (29 Nos, 1 gate light, 2 spare)
25x3mm Copper strip for fabrication of copper clamps (1 m = 2 clamps; 15 m for 29 poles)
1.5 sqmm x 2C PVC insulated sheathed copper flexible cable reputed brand, 4 m per light
Transportation charges for 29 GI Class C poles from local market to VTS Radar Station Chudeshwar Lighthouse
Red oxide primer 10 L, synthetic enamel PO red 2 coat for 34 foundations 10 L, aluminium paint 2 coat for 30 poles 7 L, thinner 10 L, brushes 4/3/2 mm 2 each
PVC insulating tape, sleeves, 2 inch GI pipe, waterproof tape, pin type/round lugs, silicon sealant and gun, cable tie, SS nut bolt etc
Labour charges
Hiring welder and welding machine
Mason hiring
Cable route marking
Aluminium folding ladder 20 feet

money.notes: Estimated bid value per GeM. EMD not required. Advisory bank State Bank of India; beneficiary Dy Director General, DGLL, Deep Bhavan, Plot 17 Sector 8, Gandhidham. MII and MSE purchase preference apply.

eligibility: Minimum average annual turnover of bidder (3 years): Rs 19 lakh; MSE and startup exemption for turnover
3 years past experience in same/similar products
Past performance: supplied 80% of bid quantity in one of last three financial years
Past project experience in preceding 3 FYs: one order >= 35%, or two >= 20% each, or three >= 15% each of estimated bid value
OEM authorisation certificate; BoQ specification compliance; escalation matrix for service support
Only Class-I and Class-II local suppliers (min 50% / 20% local content)
Total value wise evaluation; no reverse auction; single vendor, no subletting; site visit advised
specs: Street light poles in single Class C GI pipe without joints; two coats red oxide and two coats silver/aluminium paint
LED street lights 25 W, 230 V 50 Hz AC; individual 1.5 sqmm 3C armoured UG cable to each pole laid 1 ft underground, GI pipe at road crossings, sand bedding in rocky areas, route marking stones
Separate main switches/MCBs for Circuit 1 and Circuit 2 in station power house; DBs, JBs and cabling for AC distribution
All items ISI marked; detailed design drawings to be approved within 5 days of award
notes: Standard GeM BOQ bid with generic GeM clauses; total quantity 2431 across 22 line items (units not printed; separate specification/BOQ attachments not included). Listing shows end date 2022-12-12 and opening 2022-11-16 (the bid publication date), whereas the bid document prints end 30-11-2022 11:00 and opening 30-11-2022 11:30; no corrigendum attached. Chudeshwar VTS station is not in station_names.tsv. Consignee officer personal name omitted.
